races.name: Limerick Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Tyson Fury
runners_data.note: Sharp class drop from Curragh handicap gives him a significant ratings edge over this field despite hold-up style concerns
runners_data.comment: Runner-up in ordinary maiden hurdles the last twice; can't be ruled out back on the Flat
runners_data.spotlight: Takes a sharp drop in class having contested a strong 1m6f handicap at the Curragh last week; had previously shown decent form in finishing second in maiden hurdles at Tramore and Killarney; suited by the race conditions, as he was when readily landing a race of this type at Dundalk in March.

runners_data.name: Merlin The Wizard
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven 1m ability but regression in recent seasons limits ceiling
runners_data.comment: Three wins in Britain in 2023, has shown something like his best form in recent months
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins in Britain in 2023 at up to 1m; regressive in the last two seasons; produced best run for some time at Dundalk in March when good second over 1m; more recent turf form just about good enough to suggest he can make his presence felt in this grade.

runners_data.name: Taj Crown
runners_data.note: Unexposed filly open to improvement but hold-up style makes her vulnerable in this tactical scenario
runners_data.comment: Slowly away and ran green at Dundalk on her only start at three, visored now, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and ran green at Dundalk on her only start at three; made late progress in a 1m maiden at Killarney last month; unexposed filly, open to improvement but others have stronger credentials.

runners_data.name: Metamorphic
runners_data.note: 175 days off the track and hold-up style creates double handicap in likely pace setup
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel filly put in her best effort when third in a heavy ground Gowran fillies' maiden last October over an extended 1m1f; reportedly got upset in the stalls on both handicap starts at Dundalk later in the year; risky in the circumstances.

runners_data.name: Kakori
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from strong O'Brien yard but 46 days since last run questions immediate fitness
runners_data.comment: Traffic problems when sixth at Navan, could turn tables on Radar Ahead with clearer run
runners_data.spotlight: Filly with a good German pedigree; ran her best race so far when sixth in a 20-runner handicap over 1m5f at Navan in April, beaten only 3l and would have been closer with a clear run; several others have a stronger chance in theory, but perhaps unwise to rule out.

runners_data.name: Dreamed To Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits pace scenario but 5lb claimer and tendency to fade late are concerns
runners_data.comment: Rating of 67 flatters him, with fourth different trainer now, hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Rating of 64 flatters him on what he has shown in five Flat starts; tailed off at Cork on latest on his first start for a fourth different trainer.

runners_data.name: Timandi
runners_data.note: 13-race maiden with poor recent form makes her hard to recommend in any scenario
runners_data.comment: Heavy ground against her when last seen in March; ground to suit now but stamina unproven
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden; never in the first three; unlikely to improve her profile here.

runners_data.name: Glendower
runners_data.note: Placed form on quick ground but Wesley Joyce's 3lb claim helps offset 33-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Placed four times in Britain in 2024, showing a liking for quick ground; modest form over hurdles for this stable last year; after almost 12 months off, produced a much livelier display when third in a Flat maiden at Ballinrobe last month.

runners_data.name: Peace Walk
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning after 608-day absence but no pace pressure should suit if fit enough
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to prosper in handicaps after showing decent form at two; had dropped from an initial rating of 85 to 70 by the time of his final start for Charlie Johnston in 2024; gelded now; likely to need after a long absence.

runners_data.name: Wolfpack
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Thirsk win last summer and Gordon Elliott booking adds confidence
runners_data.comment: Placed on Tapeta at two and won over 1m at Thirsk last year; tailed off hurdling lately
runners_data.spotlight: Won over 1m on good ground at Thirsk last summer for James Ferguson; poor form in juvenile hurdles; a race of this type represents his best chance of adding to his tally, judged on his recent Dundalk fourth behind a stablemate of Tyson Fury.

runners_data.name: Blackjack Hills
runners_data.note: Blinkers-assisted winner last October but 217-day break and fade-in-finish pattern worry
runners_data.spotlight: Showed significant improvement in first-time blinkers to win a handicap over an extended 1m at Gowran last October; proved he could handle a sound surface with a follow-up success at Dundalk in November; went up a stone in total but will need further progress to cope with several higher-rated rivals here.

runners_data.name: Zammawar
runners_data.note: Struggles in maidens with lowest rating in field and tendency to weaken late
runners_data.comment: Poor form over various trips, easily overlooked
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled in maidens, including a Ballinrobe event in which Glendower finished third.

races.paceDynamic: Peace Walk is the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, with Dreamed To Dream and Wolfpack settling just behind in prominent positions. The lack of early pace pressure means Peace Walk can dictate fractions and kick for home when ready, while the majority of this field are hold-up horses who will need the race to develop into a sprint finish. With good to yielding ground providing a fair surface for all runners, this tactical setup strongly favours horses who can travel prominently and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge in the closing stages when multiple hold-up horses make their move simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Peace Walk gets easy fractions and stays the trip
scenarios.body: Peace Walk dictates ideal fractions under no pressure and has enough left to repel late challenges. The 608-day layoff becomes irrelevant if fitness holds as no other natural leaders emerge to pressure him.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Tyson Fury gets a clear run from off the pace
scenarios.body: The sharp class drop from Curragh handicap company tells as Tyson Fury picks his way through traffic. His hold-up style benefits from the anticipated strong pace and he has the highest official rating to exploit.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamed To Dream or Wolfpack track the leader closely
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners sits perfectly behind Peace Walk and strikes when the leader weakens in the final furlong. Their forward position avoids the traffic that traps the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses are denied clear runs
scenarios.body: The field bunches in the straight creating a cavalry charge where an unconsidered runner finds the clearest passage. A horse with early pace positioning capitalises on the others' misfortune.

watchPoints.text: Peace Walk's 608-day layoff - if he shows any signs of rustiness or blowing up in the straight, the race opens up dramatically
Traffic problems at the two-furlong pole when multiple hold-up horses make their move simultaneously behind the leaders
Tyson Fury's early position - needs to be handily placed turning in to utilise his class advantage effectively
Dreamed To Dream and Wolfpack both fade in the finish - watch for any signs of stopping in final furlong
First-time headgear on Taj Crown and Metamorphic could spark improvement from their hold-up positions

races.name: Conference & Banqueting Facilities @ Limerick Handicap

runners_data.name: Chestnut Palace

runners_data.comment: Drop back in trip to suit but may not reverse form with Eniac on Leopardstown run
runners_data.spotlight: Just okay efforts in two handicaps, not looking to stay 1m4f at Leopardstown and again didn't get home under a positive ride over 1m2f at Down Royal; cheekpieces now added but obvious stamina concerns.

runners_data.name: Blissful Bonita
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner adding cheekpieces after encouraging handicap debut behind Femme Beauty at Killarney
runners_data.comment: Debut on turf was better than two subsequent turf outings, worth considering
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't count but not beaten far on last month's handicap debut (behind Femme Beauty) at Killarney over slightly shorter; cheekpieces now added so don't rule out.

runners_data.name: Delusional
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from in-form yard who improved markedly when fitted with visor last time
runners_data.comment: Has failed to make much impact on his first two handicap attempts, needs to raise his game
runners_data.spotlight: Recent 1m3f Killarney handicap (first-time visor) third to Femme Beauty a definite step in the right direction; one to consider from a yard hitting form.

runners_data.name: Femme Beauty
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at Killarney from the front but struggled over 1m4f at Roscommon six days later
runners_data.comment: Got a good ride from the front on speed-favouring track when  beating Musashi at Killarney
runners_data.spotlight: Got a good ride from the front on speed-favouring track when winning over 1m3f at Killarney last month; didn't seem to get home over 1m4f at Roscommon six days later; 10lb claimer back aboard here.

runners_data.name: Servare
runners_data.note: Hold-up style winner at Navan in heavy ground but disappointing in longer trips since
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m2f off 12lb lower at Navan, ok run off revised mark latest, cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return at Navan in March (1m2f, heavy); not so good in 1m4f events since, upset in stalls at Cork and made much of running in first-time cheekpieces at Leopardstown before fading; headgear left off now but remains unproven at this trip; drops in grade.

runners_data.name: Leeward
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fade-in-finish warning, only front runner in field making handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred son of Frankel hasn't made an impact in three maidens over shorter but could improve for this step up in trip on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Lord Aus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who produced eye-catching late run on handicap debut, still looking green with more to offer
runners_data.comment: Potential improver upped in trip for handicap debut but may need more time
runners_data.spotlight: Eye-catching handicap debut at Down Royal last month when strong-finishing third third (Chestnut Palace 2.75l away fourth) over 1m2f, still looking green; longer trip seems sure to suit and cheekpieces added; big player.

runners_data.name: Glen Echo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fade-in-finish concern, lesser of two Cromwell runners making handicap bow
runners_data.comment: No show in recent maidens at Navan and Leopardstown; eligible for a mark after this
runners_data.spotlight: No show when well held in three decent maidens in the spring; seems the lesser likely of the Cromwell pair on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Curious Jane
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fade warning, second reserve after poor maiden form
runners_data.comment: Has finished in front of only four of her 36 rivals in three races, hard to make a case
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; three maiden runs poor, probably best watched on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Retro Gal
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from strong staying family making significant step up in trip after 63 days off
runners_data.comment: Never competitive in three maiden outing over 1m; half-sister to 1m2f AW winner
runners_data.spotlight: Never competitive in three maidens over 1m; half-sister to 1m2f AW winner and is out of a Nathaniel mare, so good chance this trip will suit; market has to be watched on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Cascade Canyon
runners_data.note: Hold-up style handicap debutant whose breeding suggests this trip extension should suit
runners_data.comment: Midfield on debut at Navan, not as good there latest, much more needed, rain would help
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debutant whose three maiden runs have been at 1m2f; potential improver upped in trip but opposable off this opening mark.

runners_data.name: Brave Approach
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is first reserve, won at Dundalk but big step up in trip on turf return
runners_data.comment: Winning h'cap debut over C&D last month; form questionable and failed to back up lto
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; winning handicap debut (1m) at Dundalk in March but safely held twice afterwards at same track; marked step up in trip for turf return and others preferred.

runners_data.name: Amethyst Stone
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fade concern from top yard, likely improver upped in trip on handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Hasn't counted in maidens at Navan and Leopardstown; more likely one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't counted in three maidens over middle-distances but likely improver upped in trip on handicap debut; yard in top form.

runners_data.name: Kirkland Sioux
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making major trip increase for handicap debut, dam won over this distance
runners_data.comment: Sioux Nation filly, soundly beaten in 7f-1m maidens, others preferred

runners_data.name: Point Cartwright
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade warning whose late headway last time suggests longer trip will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Late headway on handicap debut over 1m2f at Ballinrobe last month suggests this longer trip may suit; one to consider.

runners_data.name: The Holy Apostle
runners_data.note: Hold-up style 2yo making seasonal debut, will need to improve significantly for trip step-up
runners_data.spotlight: Standout 2yo effort when placed in Killarney nursery; quite exposed and will need to improve for this step up in trip on seasonal debut.

runners_data.name: Celestially
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fade concern, handicapper has relented after Killarney disappointment
runners_data.comment: Navan fourth on handicap debut was a step in the right direction, beaten 9l, more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Navan fourth (to Servare) on handicap debut was a step in the right direction but never sighted at Killarney behind Femme Beauty; handicapper relenting but more needed and cheekpieces tried.

runners_data.name: Sofi's Gift
runners_data.note: Hold-up style third reserve who was well beaten in spring maidens
runners_data.comment: No sign of winning potential in opening two maidens
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; beaten a long way in three maidens in the spring; hard to fancy now entering handicaps.

runners_data.name: Royal Sapphire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade warning, 0-7 maiden who could improve for significant trip increase
runners_data.comment: 0-6, has looked limited, heavy defeats in claimers last twice, hard to make a case for
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden is 0-7 over shorter trips, three times this year; could improve for the step up in trip but others look more likely.

races.paceDynamic: Leeward is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and should get an uncontested lead over this stamina-testing 1m4f trip. The prominent runners Delusional and Brave Approach may sit just behind, but with most of the field preferring to come from off the pace, Leeward will likely dictate terms throughout. The Good to Yielding ground and extended distance will test stamina reserves in the final furlong, creating opportunities for strong finishers. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained late runs, as the likely modest early pace will set up a stamina test rather than a speed battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Leeward sets modest fractions and the pace doesn't quicken until late
scenarios.body: The stamina-sapping finish will suit horses with strong finishing kicks coming from the back. Lord Aus, Femme Beauty and Point Cartwright can all produce sustained late runs over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Leeward maintains a steady gallop and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The Frankel colt could improve markedly for this step up in trip and run his rivals into the ground. Delusional sitting prominent could pick up the pieces if the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina test finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is very sedate early and becomes a pure staying contest
scenarios.body: Only the strongest stayers will prevail in a gruelling finish that finds out any with stamina limitations. Retro Gal and Kirkland Sioux could improve significantly for this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace quickens early
scenarios.trigger: If Delusional or Brave Approach press Leeward from the start
scenarios.body: A stronger early gallop could compromise the stamina reserves of many in the field. The race becomes more tactical with fewer having finishing kicks left.

watchPoints.text: Leeward could get soft fractions as the only pace angle and dictate the race from the front
Lord Aus showed significant promise on handicap debut and could have more improvement to come
Femme Beauty's Killarney win came on a speed-favouring track but she struggled over 1m4f next time
Several Ballydoyle runners including Kirkland Sioux and Royal Sapphire making big trip increases
The going report shows consistent Good to Yielding conditions across all distances throughout the card

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners_data.name: Camino Lad
runners_data.note: Unknown style but excellent pedigree suggests he could be prominent early and avoid traffic
runners_data.spotlight: Flintshire gelding cost 25,000euros as a foal; first foal; dam French 1m4f winner (inc Listed; RPR 107), half-sister to French 1m7f Group 2 winner Ponte Tresa; debutant appears the yard second-string.

runners_data.name: Pimlico Piranha
runners_data.note: Debutant with good breeding who may naturally travel forward under Whelan
runners_data.spotlight: Saxon Warrior colt is first foal of a 1m3f/12.3f winner (RPR 98), a half-sister to winners Choreography (7f 2yo) and Ardenlee Star (6f-1m inc 2yo); debutant probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Shorten The Winter
runners_data.note: Newcomer who needs to prove his worth on debut for yard in mixed form
runners_data.spotlight: Coulsty colt fetched 5,500euros as a yearling and 36,000euros later same year; third foal; half-brother to 7f/1m AW winner Callianassa (RPR 90); dam maiden half-sister to winners Amade (US 2m Grade 2) and Nakuti (1m Group 3); newcomer worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Willie's Mill
runners_data.note: First-time out for inexperienced connections, best watched with 5lb claimer up
runners_data.spotlight: Profitable gelding is first foal of an unraced half-sister to winners Goldinthesea (1m), Shawaaheq (7.4f-8.5f) and Qawamees (1m4f); best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: I Carry You Home
runners_data.note: Hold-up style who fades in finish, returning after 326 days off track
runners_data.spotlight: Too Darn Hot colt cost 70,000gns as a yearling; half-brother to five winners inc Law Power (7f-1m2f inc 2yo/Italian Listed), Perfect Clarity (1m 2yo/11.6f Listed) and Clarentine (1m AW); dam Listed-placed 7f 2yo winner (stayed 1m2f); McMonagle's pick from yard trio so debutant has to be respected.

runners_data.name: Res Ipsa
runners_data.note: Natural leader with tongue-tie fitted, perfectly placed to control this large field
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel brother to yard's smart Group 3 winner Red Letter; well fancied on sole 2yo outing but looked raw and met trouble in running; reappeared with tongue-tie fitted for much improved effort last month at Killarney, clear with odds-on winner over this trip; looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Stable Lane
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping markedly in trip from 1m4f AW efforts last year
runners_data.comment: Sent off 100-1 for debut over C&D but outran odds with a 5.75l sixth; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped okay in both 1m4f Dundalk maiden runs late last year; down markedly in trip for turf debut and eligible for a mark after this.

runners_data.name: Henry Hudson
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with only mild recent form, likely needs handicaps
runners_data.comment: Went off 50-1 when beaten 10l over 1m at Killarney and looks one for down the line
runners_data.spotlight: Only mild promise in two maidens last month, likely more one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Shay's Dream
runners_data.note: Fading hold-up type who was well beaten on debut 196 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: New Bay colt cost 36,000euros as a yearling and 35,000euros at the breeze-ups; half-brother to winners Double Effect (French 10.5f/1m4f Flat and 2m1f hurdle) and Shangri La (Spanish 6f-1m2f inc 2yo); dam French 6f 2yo winner (RPR 96); tailed off on AW debut in November; gelded since and best watched on turf debut.

runners_data.name: Roman Sands
runners_data.note: Another fader who has shown little in recent starts on similar going
runners_data.comment: Big price when down the field over 1m at Gowran
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices when down the field in recent maidens at Gowran and Fairyhouse.

runners_data.name: Highwayman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excuses last time, eligible for handicap mark after this
runners_data.comment: Slowly away and never in contention on debut at Cork, likely to need more experience
runners_data.spotlight: Well held but excuses in both recent maiden runs, slowly away at Cork and hampered at the Curragh a week ago; eligible for a mark after this.

runners_data.name: Poet's Willow
runners_data.note: Chronic fader with tongue-tie, triple-figure odds merchant over four starts
runners_data.comment: Triple figure odds for all three starts and ran accordingly, tongue-tie tried
runners_data.spotlight: Triple-figure odds for all four starts and ran accordingly.

runners_data.name: Footstepstoglory
runners_data.note: Placed hurdler making only second Flat start after poor Gowran debut
runners_data.comment: Runner up over hurdles in October, off since, related to Flat winners, check market
runners_data.spotlight: Placed hurdler never sighted on Flat debut at Gowran 9 days ago; best watched.

runners_data.name: Six Wings
runners_data.note: Fading type with tongue-tie who needs handicap company after three poor efforts
runners_data.comment: Beaten a long way in two maidens earlier this month; eligible for a mark after this
runners_data.spotlight: Awaiting a handicap mark after being soundly beaten in all three outings in May.

races.paceDynamic: Res Ipsa is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-runner maiden, meaning he can dictate terms from the front without early pressure. The large field contains mostly hold-up horses and newcomers with unknown styles, creating a scenario where the pace will be steady early before building late. With so many runners needing cover and room, this sets up perfectly for Res Ipsa to control the gallop and kick clear when it matters. This race shape strongly favours early pace and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Res Ipsa Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Res Ipsa gets an easy lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: He can quicken off steady fractions while the hold-up brigade get shuffled back in the big field. The lack of early pace pressure allows him to time his effort perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred newcomers shows natural early pace
scenarios.body: Camino Lad or Pimlico Piranha could press forward and benefit from avoiding the inevitable traffic chaos behind. Their pedigrees suggest they have the class to exploit a good position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their chance in a slowly-run affair that becomes all about the final furlong. However, with 14 runners, traffic will still be a major issue.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Reigns
scenarios.trigger: If early interference or a false pace creates mayhem
scenarios.body: The large field and mix of inexperienced horses could lead to a messy race where luck trumps ability. Any horse that gets a clear run could capitalize.

watchPoints.text: Res Ipsa could get an uncontested lead in this big field and prove very hard to peg back
Traffic problems are inevitable with 14 runners and mostly hold-up horses requiring late room
Camino Lad and Pimlico Piranha are the most interesting debutants based on their breeding
Several horses carry fade-in-finish warnings which could be crucial in a large field sprint
The going has been upgraded to Good to Yielding which may not suit all runners equally

races.name: Jim Ryan Racecourse Services Memorial Handicap

runners_data.name: Royal Saxo

runners_data.name: Fast Tara

runners_data.name: Noli Timere

runners_data.name: Highbury See See
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs cut in ground but has Heffernan booking and fair recent fourth

runners_data.name: Monvoe

runners_data.name: Dragon Of Malta

runners_data.spotlight: Has recorded three of his seven wins at Listowel; poor effort there ten days ago, when last of 13; also failed to beat a single rival at Cork on first outing of the season.

races.paceDynamic: Fast Tara and Pierre Royal will contest the early lead, with Pierre Royal returning from a long layoff potentially vulnerable to Fast Tara's recent race fitness. The prominent quartet of Royal Saxo, Noli Timere, Flame Of Forest and Dragon Of Malta will create significant congestion approaching the home turn. With 6 of 10 runners wanting forward positions, the pace should be honest throughout but not breakneck. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates traffic problems turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setters fade after their battle while the hold-up brigade get clear runs to exploit tired legs. Monvoe's recent form peak and Earls' course form become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent battle sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Saxo or Noli Timere can secure ideal position without interference
scenarios.body: The class of these two proven performers tells as they avoid the worst of the scrimmaging while maintaining striking position. Royal Saxo's French form or Noli Timere's course-and-distance experience proves key.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapse favours leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Pierre Royal's long absence doesn't blunt his speed and Fast Tara falters
scenarios.body: Pierre Royal's Dermot Weld polish shows as he dictates fractions and kicks clear when the prominent runners get in each other's way. His maiden win over this trip provides the template for victory.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving three-year-old strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Monvoe gets the perfect hold-up trip while others are compromised
scenarios.body: His recent course-and-distance wins show he's still progressing and the 3yo weight allowance becomes telling in a rough race. The step up in grade doesn't halt his momentum.

watchPoints.text: Pierre Royal could be rusty early after 370 days off, potentially compromising Fast Tara's lead
Traffic jam developing 2f out as Royal Saxo, Noli Timere, Flame Of Forest and Dragon Of Malta converge
Monvoe's late run from the back as his recent course victories suggest he peaks late
Fast Tara's stamina reserves after Sunday's Listed race effort may tell in final furlong
Earls finding his preferred hold-up position as his Roscommon form gives him edge over hold-up rivals

races.name: Twilight Summer Racing @ Limerick Handicap

runners_data.name: Usuario Amigo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who benefits from strong pace but may struggle if it becomes too tactical from the rear
runners_data.comment: Run at Naas 10 days ago not without promise and return to 7f could suit
runners_data.spotlight: 7f Brighton maiden win in September 2024; yet to score for this yard, best effort when third in a rated race here last summer (6.5f, good), testing ground probably wasn't ideal at Cork last time.

runners_data.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with good recent form who should relish a truly-run race from off the pace

runners_data.spotlight: Four wins at around this trip, most recently off 60 at Cork in April; decent third at Roscommon on latest so remains on a competitive mark; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Ardeur
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 63-day break who could be fresh enough to press the leader if required
runners_data.comment: Below form over various trips for this yard last autumn; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 6f maiden for Ralph Beckett and later some decent efforts in defeat in France up to 1m2f; hasn't had her preferred decent ground for current connections so potential improver back on better ground and drops in grade; outside draw probably not ideal.

runners_data.name: Lady Arwen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent C&D defeat suggests she needs everything to fall right tactically
runners_data.spotlight: Ended long losing run with short head victory at Gowran in April (1m, soft); safely held later in month off 4lb higher over today's C&D so needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Hexagonal
runners_data.note: Prominent type whose recent efforts suggest he's in good heart but needs to find more
runners_data.comment: Gave an improved display when second at Ballinrobe last time, others have stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden with a little enough mileage on the clock; creditable efforts in handicaps of late but more needed.

runners_data.name: Jasmine Affanalis
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good form who was only just denied over this trip last time and looks well-handicapped
runners_data.comment: Less to prove than a good few of these, non-runner on Monday at Roscommon (5.23)
runners_data.spotlight: Tipperary winner last summer was only just denied a second career win over this trip at Killarney last month; 2lb higher but major player.

runners_data.name: Perfect Judgement
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose recent runs were compromised by incidents but has ability if getting clear run
runners_data.comment: Wins all at 7f/1m; remains unproven over this far
runners_data.spotlight: Four AW wins, sole turf win came at Leopardstown (7f); didn't count on both runs last month for current yard under 7lb claimer but badly hampered by loose horse second occasion; senior rider takes over and don't rule out off career-low mark.

runners_data.name: Ohmali
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who showed good tactical speed when second at Leopardstown last time over this distance
runners_data.comment: Heavy-ground winner last season, fair form on better ground, below best on seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Heavy-ground winner over this trip at Gowran last September and handled quicker ground well at Leopardstown last month when coming from good bit back to finish second to an improver (third won next time); one to consider, despite wide draw.

runners_data.name: Java Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent Leopardstown fourth behind Ohmali suggests he's in similar form
runners_data.comment: Long-priced Dundalk winner last year, has run with credit in two turf handicaps this term
runners_data.spotlight: 40-1 win on AW/handicap debut last August and solid opening efforts on turf this season, including Leopardstown fourth (Ohmali second) over this trip; didn't count at the Curragh on latest but Keane booking takes the eye.

runners_data.name: Goofy Gander
runners_data.note: Hold-up type stepping up in trip who may need this experience over the longer distance
runners_data.spotlight: Never counted after slow start on handicap debut at the Curragh in April (6f); half-sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Trustyourinstinct so can be expected to improve as she goes up in trip; market has to be watched.

runners_data.name: Bella Colombia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose turf record is poor but has shown some decent efforts in defeat at this level
runners_data.comment: 0-13 on turf but ran well off this mark when third of 13 over 1m at Limerick last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Added a second AW win at Dundalk in March (1m); 0-14 on turf but has run some decent races in defeat, including C&D third in April; Roscommon run since was a solid one so remains on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Out On Friday
runners_data.note: Front runner whose fading tendency makes him vulnerable if the pace becomes too strong late
runners_data.comment: Probably needed Roscommon comeback run, more expected of here with ground in his favour

runners_data.name: Friars Gate
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who was slowly away last time and faces a tough task from wide draw
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; lightly raced maiden whose recent handicap debut run was hampered by a slow start; new headgear combination fitted.

runners_data.name: Robot Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent poor form and wide draw make him hard to fancy despite the trip drop
runners_data.comment: Placed on AW in France, lost ground at the start at this venue on Irish debut, 40-1 then

runners_data.name: Faire La Nouba
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long absence whose best efforts have been over longer trips
runners_data.spotlight: Limited maiden but has run well here over longer trips; hurdling last autumn and seems best watched on Flat return over an inadequate trip.

runners_data.name: Genuine Jim
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose preference for softer ground makes him less appealing on this surface
runners_data.comment: Has plenty to find with Lough Lane on running 13 days ago but should not be ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on soft, including over this trip at Cork last season; two runs this season poor and ideally wants it softer so opposable.

runners_data.name: Mags

runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Dundalk in Nov' 2024; finished last in both starts last season
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came on AW in late 2024; back from long absence when well held over C&D (first-time hood) in April and has changed yards again since.

runners_data.name: Mythical Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose multiple trainer changes suggest he's hard to place despite recent AW win
runners_data.comment: Perhaps unlucky not to finish closer on stable debut, almost lost his footing on last turn

runners_data.name: Notforalongtime
runners_data.note: Hold-up type whose turf record is poor despite being a prolific all-weather winner
runners_data.comment: Ten-time winner but just one on turf, although has taken third last twice; on a nice mark
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; prolific AW winner is just 1-29 on turf but some good placings this season at Cork and the Curragh; remains of interest off lower turf mark.

races.paceDynamic: Out On Friday is the sole confirmed front runner in this field of 19, giving him the luxury of an uncontested lead through the early stages. With most runners showing hold-up or midfield tendencies, the pace is likely to be moderate and sustainable, allowing Out On Friday to dictate terms before the field comes alive from the back in the final three furlongs. The lack of early pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish where positioning and turn of foot will be crucial. This race shape heavily favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with tactical speed who can capitalize on the expected steady gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday gets soft fractions and stays the trip better than usual
scenarios.body: The veteran sets his own pace and proves hard to peg back despite his tendency to fade, with hold-up horses closing late but running out of room. This rewards the leader and late-closing types with stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and turns into a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up a bunched finish where horses with the best turn of foot prevail from off the pace. Late runners with tactical speed dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If some runners press Out On Friday earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A slightly stronger pace develops which suits the prominent racers who can track the leader and kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized. Mid-race positioning proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday stops completely and no one takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace, suiting horses that can quicken from any position and handle the tactical nature. Jockey judgment becomes paramount.

watchPoints.text: Out On Friday could get easy fractions as the only leader but his tendency to fade late makes him vulnerable if staying power gives out
The wide draws for Robot Rock and Friars Gate could leave them with too much ground to make up in a tactical affair
Jasmine Affanalis and Java Wood finished close together at Leopardstown recently so their relative positions could be telling again
Several horses including Perfect Judgement and Friars Gate were hampered or slowly away last time so need clean breaks
The going has been called Good to Yielding all day which may not be soft enough for Genuine Jim's best efforts

races.name: Cosgrave Transport Handicap (Div I)

runners_data.name: James Henry
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 10-day break with strong late-season form, well-suited to expected steady pace
runners_data.comment: Better AW performer and has an absence of over a year to overcome

runners_data.name: Verhoyen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent Fairyhouse sixth, 11-year-old veteran may lack the finishing kick needed
runners_data.comment: Didn't ping the lids when sixth here last week, but not far behind a couple of these
runners_data.spotlight: Eight-time winner (placed 20 times) who marked his 100th appearance with a fair sixth of 18 at Fairyhouse recently, one place in front of today's rival Jazzy Dancer; almost two years since his last win; might struggle to record another success in the closing stages of his career.

runners_data.name: Lorr's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits race shape but 29 days since last run raises fitness concerns for this pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Chance on last summer's form but absent since below par during the winter and drawn wide

runners_data.name: Carvalhal

runners_data.name: Shelbourne Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making seasonal debut after 203-day absence, previous good 7f form but fitness question
runners_data.comment: Some good 7f turf runs in the summer, has to bounce back from a below-par Down Royal run
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden after 13 starts; a few good 7f turf runs last summer, notably when second over this trip at Leopardstown; first run for Noel Meade now.

runners_data.name: Racing Royalty
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner wearing blinkers returning from 240-day break, hard to assess current ability after long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came in the autumn of 2023; best 2024 form was also late in the campaign, and his only placing last season was obtained at Galway in September; hard to make a case for him on seasonal debut.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in tongue-tie coming off decent Fairyhouse seventh, recent AW win suggests return to form

runners_data.name: Linger For Longer
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner will control the pace, recent fourth at Listowel suggests improved form
runners_data.comment: Below par last year and didn't provide much encouragement on her return
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner; below par last year; faded in a 1m contest at this event on her first run of the season; more like it when fourth at Listowel ten days ago; now reunited with the champion jockey who won twice on her in 2024; worth considering.

runners_data.name: Oxford Circus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in tongue-tie with Denis Hogan's decent strike rate, disappointing recent turf form a concern
runners_data.comment: Hasn't built on promising AW debut, no sign of winning potential on turf, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Good effort when third in a 6f maiden on debut at Dundalk in February; has failed to build on that; soundly beaten in four turf handicap stars at four different trips from 5f to 1m.

runners_data.name: Bright Image
runners_data.note: Prominent early but fades in finish wearing tongue-tie, warning signs about stamina over this trip
runners_data.comment: Good effort at the Curragh on the first day of the 2024 season, absent since, best watched

runners_data.name: She's On The Ball

runners_data.name: Imnotleavinyou
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in tongue-tie with strong recent placing record, 3-year-old carries 128lbs but stays well

runners_data.name: Half Nutz

runners_data.name: Beau Army

runners_data.spotlight: Has won over 6f/7f at Dundalk and runner-up over 1m at the AW venue in April; ran his best race on turf so far when keeping on for fourth behind Meridien (a winner again since) over 7f at Down Royal 12 days ago; among those behind then was Imnotleavinyou whose previous form gives her a leading chance here.

races.paceDynamic: Linger For Longer is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, with minimal early pressure expected from this field. Verhoyen and Jazzy Dancer may sit prominent but neither is aggressive enough to challenge for the early lead. The moderate early pace will allow hold-up horses like James Henry, Shelbourne Flyer, and Imnotleavinyou to get into good positions before the turn. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses and late closers who can benefit from the anticipated steady gallop and strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Linger For Longer sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop allows hold-up horses to close strongly in the final two furlongs. Late runners with stamina reserves will surge past the early leaders who've had an easy time of it.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Linger For Longer maintains her advantage and the closers fail to organize a serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a sustained drive to the line. Prominent runners who can quicken late become the main dangers to the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If Verhoyen or Jazzy Dancer inject pace approaching the turn to put pressure on the leader
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors horses with tactical speed who can respond to the pace injection. Those caught too far back struggle to make up the ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Slow Pace
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge on the leader and create a tactical battle with no one willing to go forward
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the furlong pole with positioning crucial and stamina less important. Horses drawn well who can get a good position benefit most.

watchPoints.text: Watch Linger For Longer's early fractions - if she gets an easy lead the hold-up horses may struggle to peg her back
Monitor Imnotleavinyou's position turning for home as she needs cover and a clear run to deliver her strong late kick
Check if Verhoyen or Jazzy Dancer challenge the leader early as this would change the entire complexion of the race
James Henry needs a good pace to aim at - watch for signs of urgency from the hold-up horses approaching the turn
Observe the 3-year-olds Beau Army and She's On The Ball for signs they can handle this competitive handicap company

races.name: Cosgrave Transport Handicap (Div II)

races.paceDynamic: Harry Longabaugh is the only confirmed front runner in this 14-horse field, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure. With most runners showing hold-up or midfield tendencies, the pace will likely be steady through the early stages before quickening from the 2f pole. The lack of pace pressure should create a genuine gallop that will test stamina over this 7f trip on Good to Soft ground. This tactical setup strongly favours horses that can travel well in midfield and produce sustained finishing kicks, disadvantaging those that need strong early pace to set up their runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh gets soft fractions and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls the race completely and has enough left to resist late challengers on ground that will blunt finishing speed. Hold-up horses struggle to make up the deficit against the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly dawdling and kick becomes crucial
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a sprint finish where horses with the strongest turn of foot can unleash devastating late runs. Those with proven finishing ability thrive while the leader pays for dictating.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Travellers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If moderate early pace allows good positioning throughout
scenarios.body: Horses that can track the leader comfortably without being too far back get first run on the field. They avoid the disadvantages of both leading and coming from too far behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh goes too slow and stops completely
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery where any horse still on the bridle 1f out can win regardless of ability. Form becomes irrelevant as it turns into a pure sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Harry Longabaugh's early fractions will determine the entire race dynamic - if he goes too slow he becomes very beatable
Multiple hold-up runners including Zabriskie Point, Green Icon, and Gobi Star have shown concerning finishing problems recently
Exceeding and Methgal both raced at Listowel 10 days ago and meet again under different conditions
Several runners including Unfamiliar and Queen Of Newark show prominent tendencies but have fading patterns in their recent form
First-time blinkers on Sosperi after 257-day absence could spark improvement or indicate desperation from connections

races.name: Racing Again On June 19th Handicap

runners_data.name: Autumn Twist
runners_data.note: Front runner with uncontested lead advantage but form below best this spring under both codes
runners_data.comment: Form this spring below-best under both codes and others hold stronger claims
runners_data.spotlight: Ballinrobe maiden (1m2f) win last summer sandwiched by two hurdle sucesses, all on good ground; form this spring below-best under both codes however and unproven over this far.

runners_data.name: Loyal Touch
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Denis Hogan yard, five-time British winner but struggling over hurdles lately
runners_data.comment: Five-time British Flat winner but not at same level for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain at up to 1m2f; not at same level for this yard, well beaten over hurdles last twice.

runners_data.name: Quiz Test
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up type with solid recent form including Galway third, well-backed last time out
runners_data.comment: Almost three years since his only win, fair form last autumn, may improve from a Cork run
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came at Cork in 2023; decent form last autumn, including a close third over 1m4f at Galway and second in a 19-runner contest at the Curragh; well-backed on latest of two runs this term when fourth at Gowran (Good Onya Mate second); 5lb claimer now rides but more exposed than that rival.

runners_data.name: Ellaat
runners_data.note: Dual-purpose 10-year-old in good form after recent hurdle second, proven at this track and trip
runners_data.comment: No handicap hurdle win since 2022, poor start for this yard on Flat latest
runners_data.spotlight: Dual purpose 10yo whose Flat wins include 1m4f handicap here; comes here in good form after hurdle second at Ballinrobe last month off a fair mark.

runners_data.name: Our Lucky Lady
runners_data.note: Recently returned to Flat with hooded win at Down Royal, strong market support suggests confidence
runners_data.comment: Proven a better hurdler since last running on the Flat; hood tried and may improve
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler returned to Flat recently to justify strong market support when hooded first-time in 2m Down Royal handicap under today's rider, beating Sunday's Navan winner Jurality with some authority; hit with 12lb rise but could well play a role.

runners_data.name: Nod Of Approval
runners_data.note: Improved when stepped up to 1m4f last time, second at Cork after tardy start suggests more to come
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to Puturhandstogether a potential improver now upped markedly in distance
runners_data.spotlight: Best run yet on latest when upped to 1m4f in Cork handicap in April, coming from good bit back after tardy start when second to an improver (won again next time); half-brother to Irish Cesarewitch winner Puturhandstogether could well improve again now upped further in distance.

runners_data.name: Bynx
runners_data.note: Three-time hurdles winner but 0-21 on Flat, went close over this trip at Thurles off today's mark
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles, 1-4 over fences, this more suitable than latest, chance
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner (also chase winner) is 0-21 on the Flat but went close over this trip at Thurles last autumn off today's mark; can't rule out.

runners_data.name: Riyami
runners_data.note: Four-time AW winner at 2m but 0-12 on turf, recent form under both codes leaves him vulnerable
runners_data.comment: Sole hurdles win nearly two years ago; fitter for recent Flat run but unproven at 3m
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time AW winner at 2m; 0-12 on turf and recent form under both codes leaves him with a bit to find.

runners_data.name: Tatum
runners_data.note: Excellent last season with two Leopardstown wins, 1m2f too sharp on return so step up in trip helps
runners_data.comment: Two wins at Leopardstown last year, 1m2f too sharp on latest, do better now; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed an excellent campaign last season which included two wins at Leopardstown (1m4f/1m5f, good); 1m2f too sharp on return there last month, interesting now upped further in trip here with Keane aboard.

runners_data.name: Pass The Buck
runners_data.note: Fades in finish and will struggle with step up in trip, 3lb wrong on second handicap attempt
runners_data.spotlight: Recent Ballinrobe maiden run was okay but will have to improve a fair bit for this step up in trip to make an impact on second handicap attempt (3lb wrong).

runners_data.name: Mr Rango
runners_data.note: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft/heavy but latest win over two years ago, form plateau evident
runners_data.comment: Fair form this season but needs to find extra, ran in the 7.50 at Roscommon on Monday
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner at 1m2f on soft or heavy, latest over two years ago; fair form this season but good bit to find with a couple of these on recent Leopardstown run and remains unproven over this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Lauderdale King
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced improver who came home well into third at Cork over 1m2f, fading tendency concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced 4yo; nicely improved when upped in trip for handicap debut at Cork last month, coming home well into third over extended 1m2f (soft-to-heavy); interesting if he can continue improving at this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Miss Australie
runners_data.note: Got off the mark at Roscommon last month from off the pace, 5lb rise makes task harder
runners_data.comment: Bit of encouragement last time at Ballinrobe when some late headway over 9.5f
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the 15th attempt in 1m4f Roscommon handicap last month (yielding-to-soft), coming from off the pace; 5lb rise so more needed but respected.

runners_data.name: Sioux Grit
runners_data.note: Returns from 753-day absence having never won in 18 attempts, fading tendency and 9lb wrong
runners_data.comment: Second reserve; 0-18 and absent two years; 8lb wrong here
runners_data.spotlight: Mare returns from over two year's absence and hasn't troubled the judge in 18 previous attempts; 9lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Almenfee
runners_data.note: German winner failed to fire for this yard, declining mark but still best watched for now
runners_data.comment: German winner yet to fire for this yard; wants good ground
runners_data.spotlight: German winner has failed to fire so far for this yard; declining mark but still best watched.

runners_data.name: Good Onya Mate
runners_data.note: Improved on second handicap attempt over 1m6f at Gowran but fading tendency a concern here
runners_data.comment: Chance is not obvious, but the stable had a massive-priced double at Naas on Sunday
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely improved on second handicap attempt when enterprisingly-ridden over 1m6f at Gowran last month, green but rallying after being headed to finish a clear second (Quiz Test fourth); good chance he'll get this trip and likely more to offer.

races.paceDynamic: Autumn Twist is the only confirmed front runner in this 16-runner field, giving her the luxury of an uncontested lead over this 2m1f trip. With all other runners holding up or sitting mid-division, she can dictate a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The massive hold-up contingent will create a cavalry charge in the final 3-4 furlongs as they all try to make their moves simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours the early leader and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably engulf the back markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Autumn Twist gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: She can utilise her front-running style to maximum effect without pace pressure, building an unassailable advantage as the hold-up horses get in each other's way behind. Her recent form may be patchy but this tactical advantage is enormous in a race where 15 others will be playing catch-up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the massive contingent of hold-up horses creates a wall of traffic in the straight
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady early but become frantic late as 14+ horses try to weave through gaps simultaneously, allowing the most patient and best-positioned closers to emerge. Those with the strongest finishing kicks and best positioning will prevail.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the few horses sitting closer to the pace can track Autumn Twist and pounce late
scenarios.body: They avoid both the loneliness of leading and the traffic chaos behind, getting first run on the leader while the pack is still scrambling. This requires tactical awareness from jockey and horse working in perfect harmony.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Autumn Twist goes too slowly early and gets swamped by the entire field in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge from the 3f pole with stamina and finishing speed paramount as 15 horses fan out across the track. Raw ability trumps tactics in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Autumn Twist must be monitored early - if she gets soft fractions she becomes very dangerous with her uncontested lead
Traffic problems in straight are inevitable with 15+ hold-up horses - watch for those drawn high who can stay wide
Our Lucky Lady raced hooded when winning last time but no headgear declared today - significant change
Quiz Test has been well-backed in recent runs suggesting stable confidence - market moves worth noting
Tatum drops back from 1m2f where she looked rusty - this longer trip should suit her better after excellent 2023 campaign
